per_case_viewing.action_trigger: At 1800 ms panel.choose(5:komga:series-016), following sources.open(komga) at 450 ms, sources.migrate(komga) at 900 ms and panel.page(99999) at 1350 ms.
per_case_viewing.concrete_observation: The native portrait frame shows a full-width bottom migration sheet below the detail preview. Three separate unchecked rows retain readable full target titles, source/author/8-chapter subtitles and distinct exact, near and check-title hints in the right column. Preserve-read and preserve-category switches are on; remove-downloads is off. Cancel is outlined and Start migration is gray. The origin cover is a labeled native placeholder; the long detail title and preview end with ellipses.
per_case_viewing.intentional_capability_check: The declared failed/backoff origin cover remains a truthful placeholder. Real provider text differs from the sample without hiding any candidate title-hint class or chapter count. The PW5 sheet uses the related SC migration control contract, with content-driven native geometry; no exact SC/PW pixel equivalence or unsupported hardware capability is claimed.

mechanical_evidence.recorded_assertions: The existing owner case records migration modal/context, origin current_book, three actual alternate-source candidates, migration_can_start=false and settled cover work with one visible failure. These are owner-reported assertions, not a substitute for viewing.

per_case_viewing.visible_operation_feedback: All three selection squares are visibly empty and Start migration is visibly inactive; the candidate titles, counts and three match hints are directly readable.
per_case_viewing.behavior_limits: This frame qualifies the settled visible candidate presentation. It does not prove search quality, pointer hit areas, provider availability, migration completion, persistence or physical e-ink behavior.

per_case_viewing.intentional_capability_check: The declared origin-cover backoff remains truthfully visible. Selection changes the square and action appearance without shifting or clipping the candidate rows. Real titles and content-driven PW5 sheet height are assessed against related contracts; no unqualified hardware or authorization feature is inferred.

mechanical_evidence.recorded_assertions: The existing owner case records selected identity 15:komga-alternate:series-016, the matching native candidate selected=true and migration_can_start=true. No action or assertion was rerun by this reviewer.

per_case_viewing.visible_operation_feedback: The filled first square and active black Start migration button visibly distinguish this frame from the unselected candidate frame.
per_case_viewing.behavior_limits: The PNG qualifies visible selection and enabled-action feedback only. It does not independently prove that Start commits, that preserve switches retain data, or that physical input can activate the controls.

per_case_viewing.action_trigger: At 3850 ms migration.start with an empty value, after migration.select(15:komga-alternate:series-016) at 3400 ms; the recorded capture exits at 6850 ms.
per_case_viewing.concrete_observation: The migration sheet is gone. The detail preview now has an uppercase ellipsized target title, an Alternate local Komga fixture source label and a visible cover bitmap with a gray block. The reading action shows chapter 1 and 1/6 pages. The catalog shows 8 chapters, 8 unread and 0 downloaded; six rows numbered 8 through 3 retain dates, separate download buttons and dotted rules. Long chapter-title prefixes are ellipsized, with chapter numbers distinguishing the rows. The bottom folio is 1/2. No success toast is visible in this settled frame.
per_case_viewing.intentional_capability_check: No additional exception is used. Target title, cover and chapter data are permitted real-content variation. The PW detail hierarchy, distinct chapter numbers, action bounds, dates, rules and bottom folio remain legible under the related default-detail contract. The earlier origin-placeholder exception is not used to claim a successful target image or hardware capability.

mechanical_evidence.recorded_assertions: The existing owner case asserts current_book=15:komga-alternate:series-016 and durable library membership target=true/origin=false, with the modal closed. These are owner-reported existing assertions; the reviewer did not inspect a database, execute runtime work or verify persistence.

per_case_viewing.behavior_limits: The target detail frame does not independently establish durable membership, preserved read/category data, origin-network isolation or completion-toast timing. Such claims remain outside this bounded static visual review.

limitations: All four cases are supplemental states without an independent exact export. Verdicts are bounded related-contract judgments, not exact-reference pixel acceptance.
Every assigned original was opened once within the eight-open budget. No additional image queue, crop or image processing was used; required details were readable.
Mechanical assertion results and visible operation feedback are separate. No local or remote test, build, runtime, SQL, SSH or hash verification was executed.
Screenshots do not qualify hidden hit regions, physical input, e-ink effects, hardware rotation/sleep, performance, provider reliability or durable application behavior.
No historical requirements were assigned. No prior candidate verdict, historical repair or regression closure was imported, and no full-round or clean-round claim is made.
